native_result.query: In which century did the Diversity in Pottery Form collapses and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases simultaneuosly?
native_result.HypoA: Around 1800 BCE, Diversity in Pottery Form collapses, while Diversity in Pottery Decoration increases.
native_result.HypoB: Diversity in Pottery Form collapsed and Diversity in Pottery Decoration increased simultaneously in the 17th century BCE (1700 BCE / CE -1700 / 3650 calBP), during which Pottery Form diversity dropped by 1.87 Z-score units (from 0.74 to -1.13) and Pottery Decoration diversity rose by 1.45 Z-score units (from -0.48 to 0.97).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Loaded time_series_data.csv and capital.csv. 2. Filtered original centennial observations for PotteryForm and PotteryDecoration. 3. Computed first-order differences forward in time across the 37 centennial steps (-4100 to -500 CE). 4. Identified intervals satisfying diff_PotteryForm < 0 and diff_PotteryDecoration > 0, identifying 1700 BCE (17th century BCE) as the unique simultaneous event.
